evidence: All code resides in a single top-level package 'PyPaperBot', indicating no service boundaries or external process separation
Modules (files) have clear domain responsibilities (e.g., Paper, Downloader, Crossref, Scholar) with low interdependencies as seen in average fan-out of 3.75
Direct imports between modules within the package using relative imports (e.g., from .Paper import Paper) indicate tight coupling but clear modularity
No evidence of ports/adapters separation (no explicit interfaces/ports), nor layered architecture with clear separation of presentation/business/data layers
Single entry point (__main__.py) orchestrates components, typical of monolithic designs
No remote communication patterns (e.g., HTTP clients for other services, message queues, gRPC)
Directory structure is flat with depth=2, suggesting organization by domain/functionality rather than architectural layers
risks: Monolithic structure may hinder scalability and independent deployment
Tight coupling between modules (e.g., Downloader importing from HTMLparsers, Scholar importing from Crossref) could reduce maintainability over time
Lack of clear architectural layers may lead to circular dependencies or mixed concerns as project grows
